product_one_liner.value: WellnessLiving is an all-in-one business management platform for wellness, fitness, health and beauty businesses, combining booking, client management, payments, marketing, loyalty programs, reporting and AI tools.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans and monthly prices are displayed.

named_customers.notes: Both businesses are featured in WellnessLiving customer case studies.

founded_year.notes: Uses the founding year stated in the company's own announcement; one third-party database lists 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains business advice, marketing, customer stories and release highlights; no qualifying set of two engineer-authored implementation posts was found.

public_docs.notes: A public help center has multiple articles, and its API guide links to developer documentation, endpoint references and tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: An AI Solutions Engineer posting has an active application option.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini powers CAASI; OpenAI GPT-4 powers Isaac.
model_provider.notes: The providers are disclosed for two distinct AI assistants.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims a SOC 2 Type 2 report and HIPAA audits/compliant software; GDPR is named specifically for breach-notification compliance. ISO 27001 certification belongs to AWS, while PCI-DSS attestations belong to payment-processing partners.

last_funding.notes: The August 16, 2022 transaction comprised a $46 million minority equity investment plus $20 million in CIBC growth financing, totaling $66 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed financing is dated August 16, 2022, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Business Development Representative posting is dated November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 28, 2026, WellnessLiving announced general availability of CAASI Chat Agent and CAASI Phone Agent.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jay Hedges' profile lists a July 2026 start as VP Sales at WellnessLiving.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting specifies managing pipeline in Salesforce; the Sales Operations Manager posting specifies administering Zoho CRM.
